INSURANCE ACT (AMENDMENT OF THE THIRD SCHEDULE)
REGULATIONS 2025 MADE BY THE GOVERNOR ACTING ON THE
ADVICE OF CABINET UNDER SECTION 200(1)(C) OF THE
INSURANCE ACT (CAP. 11.20).
1. Citation
These Regulations may be cited as the Insurance Act (Amendment
of the Third Schedule) Regulations, 2025.
2. Third Schedule amended
The Third Schedule of the Insurance Act (Cap. 11.20) is deleted
and substituted with the following—
“THIRD SCHEDULE
(Sections 13(1), 70, 79(1), 180 and 192)
